successors.name: Yangshao culture
successors.text: Wu'an, Hebei, the type site "on the eastern foothills of the Taihang Mountains"; Handan stands in for the Hebei-Henan range of the infobox (the disc's Shandong cells are left to the Houli culture)

ledger.x: 6000 BCE: the Cishan millet farmers hold the Taihang foothills of southern Hebei and northern Henan (the culture "(6500-5000 BC)" began before the project's first year).
5000 BCE: the Cishan gives way to the Yangshao culture; the page does not describe the transition.

certainty.note: Known from the type site and the infobox range only; no border is recorded.
